name: static-mad-analysis
description: Evidence-first analysis of static-image MAD, manga MAD, AMV, and highly edited narrative video.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-based temporal and montage analysis for static-image video.
interface.longDescription: Analyze static-image MAD, manga MAD, AMV, and other highly edited narrative videos through adaptive sampling, subject tracking, time-space reconstruction, montage grammar, audio profiling, and optional cost-gated Qwen video understanding.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this static MAD with timestamped evidence.
Reconstruct the subjects and time-space relations in this video.
Critique this static MAD's montage, animation, and audio-visual rhythm.
